# Repository guidance for GitHub Copilot

Follow the repository-wide rules in `AGENTS.md`. Check the relevant scoped
instruction under `.github/instructions/` before editing backend, frontend, or
AI code. Treat `docs/openapi.yaml` as the shared API contract and preserve its
request and response shapes.

Do not invent citations or game-rule facts. AI rule answers must cite retrieved
source pages/sections and clearly say when the available material cannot answer
the question.
